newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM VS ATLETICO MADRID TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM VS ATLETICO MADRID TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final first leg match between Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands and Atletico Madrid of Spain.

Ajax - 1-Edwin van de Saar, 3-Danny Blind, 4-Frank de Boer, 6-Ronald de Boer, 7-Tijani Babangida, 8-Richard Witschge, 9-Patrick Kluivert, 10-Jari Litmanen, 11-Marc Overmars, 18-Kiki Musampa, 29-Mario Melchiot.
Atletico - 1-Jose Molina, 3-Toni Munoz, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 6-Santi Denia, 9-Juan Esnaider, 10-Milinko Pantic, 14-Diego Simeone, 15-Carlos Aguilera, 20-Delfi Geli, 21-Jose Caminero, 24-Radek Bejbl.
